title: Root and tuber storage guide
context: Roots and tubers (cassava, yam, potato, sweet potato) spoil quickly without proper curing and storage; open plain-language guidance is scattered.
objective: Write a plain-language guide to curing and storing common roots and tubers to extend shelf life, summarizing established open guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers curing, ventilation, temperature/humidity basics, and damage/rot prevention
Covers at least 3 crops (e.g. cassava, yam, sweet potato)
Cites >=2 authoritative open sources with links
